title: Home · browse first
note: Public products, categories and merchants. No account or permission wall.

title: Home · area selected
note: Optional confirmed location improves offers. Do not label fallback coordinates as detected.

title: Shop by category
note: Category tree; no merchant or admin taxonomy editing.

title: Search & filters
note: Search q, categories and supported sort. Actual merchant listing selected before Add.

title: Local shops
note: Merchant cards; fees shown in basket, not invented on cards.

title: Shop storefront
note: Shop product listing IDs, stock, price and merchant identity.

title: Product & sellers
note: Global productId for detail; merchantProductId for Add. Do not silently switch seller.

title: Global catalogue
note: Catalogue-only items have no price or seller. Check availability instead of Add.

title: Your basket
note: Guest cart works without login. Quantity updates preserve the merchant listing.

title: Two-shop basket
note: Group products and delivery fees by shop. Shared fees displayed once.

title: Delivery details
note: Guest address is a local draft until identity; no unauthorized address write.

title: Delivery area
note: Manual browsing plus optional native permission. No forced map or sign-in at launch.

title: Confirm delivery pin
note: Illustrative preview, not GPS. Use existing real native map/coordinates in production.

title: Sign in at checkout
note: Phone OTP or Google. New and returning customers share the same entry.

title: Verify phone
note: Auth verification then merge, reprice and final review. Never automatically place.

title: Basket merged · review
note: Show added existing-account items/quantities. Review after authenticated merge.

title: Final order review
note: Verified customer address and priced basket. Explicit Place order after login.

title: Order sent
note: COD sent to merchant is not accepted, paid or delivered.

title: Track your delivery
note: Per-delivery status, last known rider location and customer-only code when returned.

title: Track two deliveries
note: Parent and child IDs retained. Each shop may be at a different status.

title: Order details
note: Stored line snapshots and totals. Cancellation only where current service permits.

title: Your orders
note: Customer-owned orders, capped in baseline source. No lifetime totals or fake pagination.

title: Account · guest
note: Private actions may request login deliberately; public shopping remains available.

title: Account · member
note: Customer details and preferences. No merchant or rider role switcher.

title: Saved addresses
note: Customer address CRUD; known address IDs and account scope.

title: Edit delivery address
note: Write address only when authenticated. Keep map pin and text independently editable.

title: Appearance
note: Light, Dark, System. Preserve basket, draft and navigation on theme change.

title: Help & support
note: Order-linked and general support using real authorized tickets, no fake live chat.

title: Report an order issue
note: Create ticket only after explicit submit; errors never display sent.

title: Review a replacement
note: Customer approval is separate from merchant suggestion; refetch totals after decision.

title: Rate delivered order
note: Actual rate DTO and eligibility; no forced review to finish shopping.

title: Empty basket
note: Only confirmed empty data. Not the same as loading or network failure.

title: Outside delivery area
note: Keep catalogue browsing available; do not fake nearby availability.

title: No search results
note: Keep the search term and recover without changing authentication.

title: Loading catalogue
note: Stable skeletons, no fabricated zero price or stock.

title: Connection problem
note: Honest retry; never load demo records as a production fallback.

title: Price / stock changed
note: Explicit review before submission; no silent quantity changes.

title: Session expired
note: Basket/draft recovery without exposing private data or auto-placing.

title: Order result uncertain
note: Check confirmed orders before retrying; do not blindly replay order creation.

title: Payment pending
note: Provider-gated. No client-side mock-confirm operation in production.

title: Order updates
note: Authenticated notification feed and read actions; no fictional unread counts live.

title: Merge not confirmed
note: Preserve both contexts; additive merge needs backend idempotency for safe retry.
